response.sql: WITH per_site AS (SELECT p.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_ram, AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_site_ram, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: The 60.8 GB cutoff is inclusive. A zero CPU value makes the ratio undefined and is ignored by AVG.

alternatives.interpretation: Only runs using more than 60.8 GB qualify.
